note: CRC Credit Bureau's own FAQ, read on 2026-11-03: a private company licensed under Nigerian law to run a consumer and corporate credit bureau; its reports cover the last six years of history (the Central Bank requiring the data kept up to ten years), and nothing is removed unless it's an error: written as keep 6, what a lender reading the report sees, with no clears. Commentaries on the Credit Reporting Act 2017 read its section 5 the same way (at least six years), the section's own words not reached. CRC is one of the bureaus the Central Bank licenses (FirstCentral's site is behind a Cloudflare check). No source states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: CRC Credit Bureau, Frequently Asked Questions
sources.said: Who is CRC? CRC Credit Bureau Limited is a private limited liability company licensed under Nigerian law, created to operate a consumer and corporate credit bureau in Nigeria. ... For how many years is my data stored by CRC? Reports cover the last 6 years of history, but the Central Bank mandates data retention for up to 10 years. Can I choose to delete certain information from my credit report? No. Unless it's an error, information cannot be removed.
